name: Clairette de Die

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation for sparkling white wine. Most is labeled méthode ancestrale, mainly from Muscat à Petits Grains and finished in bottle from partly fermented must, so it is low in alcohol and sweet. A traditional-method wine is also made from Clairette alone.
